title: Per-player game logs for 2026-11-18, read from the stored official game pages

provenance.capture: data/raw/session-e3d25abc/gamepages/2026-11-18/ (gzipped by scripts/capture_official_e3d25abc.py on a GitHub Actions runner; SHA-256 re-verified here)
provenance.second_source: the official gamebook PDF of the same game, archived content-addressed beside it

rule: One row per (game, player). A player who did not appear is a row with played=false and null stats, never a dropped row. Minutes/points/rebounds/assists are the official page's own values; per team the parsed points must equal the printed score and the parsed minutes must equal 240:00 (+25:00 per OT) or the run reports it under problems.
